Every new technology meets resistance. So how do you decide which fights are worth having?

In Episode 3 of AI Decoded, Oliver Howley sits down with Nathan Barksdale , General Counsel and VP of Operations at Perplexity , to discuss how the company approaches litigation strategically.

Nathan explains why Perplexity sees it as defending its rights and users’ access to information, and why he believes the publishers most open to AI will be the ones that thrive. The episode also covers the diverging approaches to AI regulation across the U.S., the EU, the UK and Asia-Pacific, and the biggest misconception customers bring to AI contracts.

Watch the full episode: https://bit.ly/3WO4dgm
